newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania shares mixed, some gains seen possible.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania shares mixed, some gains seen possible.

text.p: Trading was mixed at Lithuania's stock exchange by the close on Monday but brokers said there may be some slight advances this week on an overall dull bourse.
The official index of leading shares advanced 7.06 points to 887.38 points but the more wide ranging group A index declined 15.57 points to 1884.25 points.
"I expect the market to be slightly up this week but I don't see any strong, overall trend," said Robertas Berzhinskas, a broker with Vilnius Bank.
"I feel some interest from clients and see activity in brokers," Berzhinskas added.
Rokishkis Cheese turned over three million litas in a block trades at 40 litas. On the central market it was quieter, advancing to 43 litas from 42 on turnover of 20,000 litas.
Brokers explained advances by Rokishkis Cheese and textiles group Medienos Plaushas, which rose to 12 litas from 11.10 litas on light turnover, on plans by both companies to issue GDRs.
Dealers said that local and foreign interest may keep the prices of both shares buoyant.
Medienos Plaushas said last week it had agreed with the Bank of New York to convert about 30 percent of its current shares into GDRs while Rokishkis is to issue GDRs via Williams de Broe.

In other trading Tuesday, Hermis Bank maintained its recent advance, rising to 188 litas from 185 litas on tiny central market volume but turning over a good 935,000 litas at 187 litas in block trades.
Hermis Bank has been advancing steadily and brokers say it may settle around 190 litas to 200 litas.
